title: Q-EVIDENCE-UNIFY: executor evidence goes through ledger.publish (one append route to loop-evidence)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** EVIDENCE-APPEND-1 merged
**Done check:** grep:scripts/executor_evidence.sh::ledger.publish
**Status:** open

scripts/executor_evidence.sh checks out loop-evidence and appends with grep -vxFf, a second route beside foundation/ledger.publish (EVIDENCE-APPEND-1). Replace its checkout, append and push with a call to ledger.publish for ops/executor-log.jsonl, ops/selfcode/ledger.jsonl and ops/agent-cost.jsonl, so one tested route writes every ledger and a rejected push rebuilds on the new tip. Test: tests/foundation/test_ledger_publish.py.
